text:
zoe: New hire report: quickstart broke because docker-compose examples use REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY while SDKs expect REDWOOD_API_KEY. New hires wasted 10–15m. Can we pick one canonical env name?

miguel: Agreed we should standardize. My vote: REDWOOD_API_KEY as canonical. Also call out REDWOOD_ORG and REDWOOD_PROJECT for explicit scoping instead of embedding scope in the key string.

rahul: Parity note: Go sampleapp still reads REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY. I'll add a tiny compat layer that accepts the legacy var but emits one-time deprecation log per process.

zoe: CI gotcha: GH Actions masks secrets by name. If teams use multiple env names across examples, some workflows won't mask values reliably. Recommend documenting exact secret names to set in project settings and a sample workflow that uses secrets.REDWOOD_API_KEY.

miguel: Rotation proposal: support POST /v1/auth/session to exchange long-lived lk_... keys for short-lived st_... session tokens. SDKs should prefer short-lived tokens in CI; sampleapps should include a ci_swap_token.sh helper. Also propose adding header X-Auth-Grace-Seconds to token responses so rolling deploys have a short overlap window.

rahul: SDK behavior: do not retry 401. Return a RedwoodAuthError with code "maybe_rotated" and a human hint. Also emit a one-time telemetry event auth.rotation_suspected per process when a 401 with Authorization header is observed so ops can detect mass expiries. JS currently retries 401 once because retry logic groups it with 5xx — we should special-case it.

ci-bot: automated link: https://git.redwood/internal/docs/auth-env-template (auto)

zoe: Action items: 1) Docs update to canonicalize REDWOOD_API_KEY + scoping envs + CI masking guidance (miguel), 2) SDK compatibility patches to accept legacy vars but warn (rahul + eng teams), 3) sampleapps: add ci_swap_token.sh and a GH Actions workflow example that demonstrates rotating and exporting REDWOOD_API_KEY (me). Target: 5 business days.

miguel: I'll draft the docs and include examples for docker-compose, docker run, and GH Actions, plus the X-Auth-Grace-Seconds suggestion.

rahul: I'll take SDK patches (JS/Python/Go) and the telemetry hook.

zoe: Thanks — landing this should cut onboarding churn significantly :)
